description: Send a brand's request on one Rate of a creator. Piku emails the brand a confirm link; the request reaches the creator's Deals only after the brand confirms, within 48 hours. Needs the creator's handle, the Rate id, the brand's name and contact email, and a short brief, as the user gave them. When the Rate has questions (get_page_info), pass answers by question id: every required one, and a choice exactly as one of its options. Returns a request_id.

answers.description: Answers to the Rate's questions from get_page_info, by question id, like {"q1": "Skincare"}. Never an ID number.

brief.description: What the brand needs, in a few lines

rate_id.description: The Rate's id from get_page_info, like ig-reel

name: submit_request
title: Send a request
